name: code-review
description: Portable code-review skill conformance: source adapters, surface bands, primary-first default, merge-blocker filing, anti-thrash / contextual re-review, escalation on demand, no-commit behavior

scenarios.name: staged: merge-blockers only
scenarios.prompt:
Review my staged changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts with default merge-blocker filing only. Review only; do not edit files or commit.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` first, then inspect the staged diff. Required header includes `Reviewer: primary` and `source:staged-only`.

judge: The review uses default merge-blocker filing, primary reviewer only, and does not file test-inventory or polish findings under Action

scenarios.name: staged: standard structured
scenarios.prompt:
Review my staged changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts before I open a PR. Do not edit files; review only.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` first, then inspect the staged diff. Required header includes `Reviewer: primary`.

judge: The transcript contains a structured primary code review for the requested file without editing files or spawning council

scenarios.name: commit: primary review
scenarios.prompt:
Review the latest commit that touches agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts. Default merge-blocker filing. Review only; no edits or commits.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` first, then inspect the commit diff. Required header includes `source:commit` and `Reviewer: primary`.

judge: The agent reviewed a commit diff with primary reviewer and produced a structured synthesis

scenarios.name: branch: focused primary (scoped UI)
scenarios.prompt:
Review the branch diff for agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/form.tsx only (main...HEAD). Client-only UI — primary focused pass. Default merge-blocker filing. Review only; no edits.

Required header includes `Reviewer: primary` and `Surface: focused`. Read the diff and `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`, then produce the Review · report.

judge: The review stays primary on a small scoped UI diff and does not escalate to council

scenarios.name: branch: auth primary deep
scenarios.prompt:
Review the branch diff for auth/session handling in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/auth.ts. Default merge-blocker filing. Primary deep pass on auth risk — escalate only if unresolved. Review only; no edits.

Read the diff and `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`, then produce the Review · report.

judge: The review deepens primary attention on auth/session, files or discusses merge-blockers, and does not mandate council spawn

scenarios.name: re-review: targeted contextual primary
scenarios.prompt:
Re-review the branch diff for agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts (main...HEAD) after fixes. Prior Action finding theme_id `query-preservation` is open. Diff only touches that theme. Run anti-thrash preflight; primary targeted closure. Default merge-blocker filing. Review only; no edits.

Required header includes `Pass: targeted contextual`, `Reviewer: primary`, and `closure-re-review`. Produce full Review · report after tools.

judge: The re-review stays primary targeted contextual after anti-thrash, reconstructs prior themes, uses findings-first output without a Fix-loop theme table, and does not invent a sibling Action theme

scenarios.name: branch: thrash signal collapse
scenarios.prompt: Review the branch diff for agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts (main...HEAD). Two adjacent blocker candidates share one theme family. Apply thrash signal: collapse into one theme with same-invariant sweep. Primary review. Default merge-blocker filing. Review only; no edits.

judge: The review applies the thrash signal, collapses adjacent same-family blockers into one theme_id with an explicit same-invariant Sweep, and does not file sibling Action blocks for each edge
